subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Albanian Pyramid Crisis
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Albanian Pyramid Crisis.

hook.text: In 1997, pyramid schemes collapsed an entire country. Albania nearly descended into civil war.

buildup.text: After communism fell, Albanians had no experience with markets. Pyramid schemes promised 100% returns.

discovery.text: Two-thirds of the population invested. The schemes held more money than the national budget.

twist.text: When the schemes collapsed, riots erupted. The government fell. Over 2,000 people died.

climax.text: Albania became the only country where pyramid fraud toppled the government and triggered anarchy.

punchline.text: When a nation gambles on fraud, everyone loses.

quiz.question: What happened in Albania when pyramid schemes collapsed in 1997?
options: Riots erupted and the government fell
